subject_session: Jenkins MC_Maze full (2009-09-25), plus 000138/000139/000140/000129/000127 as cross-session/control

headline_stat.name: held-out single-trial velocity decoding R^2 (vx, vy)

stated_limitation: The smallest maze session (100 trials) has a flat, double-peaked lag curve whose per-fold optimal lead spans the entire range tested, so its nominally negative lead should not be read as a real difference. And a control that was not anticipated: split-half estimates of a unit's movement-epoch preferred direction agree almost perfectly (R = 0.96, 98% within 45deg), yet the delay-period preferred direction of the same unit is essentially unrelated to its movement preferred direction (R = 0.13, 31% within 45deg).

justification.dataset: MC_Maze (000128), macaque motor cortex delayed center-out and maze reaching, is the canonical dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning, with five additional sessions across two areas as controls.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct per-file unit conversions, gap-safe pynapple time support, explicit min-rate quality filtering, and defensible movement/planning epoch definitions.
justification.analysis: Cosine tuning with a permutation null, circular statistics (resultant length, Rayleigh, circular s.d. bootstrap), a symmetric-kernel lag sweep, time-block cross-validation to avoid autocorrelation leakage, nested NeMoS Poisson GLMs, and a cross-area sign-reversal test are all appropriate and correctly controlled.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (130/150 tuned, R=0.161, decoding R^2 0.624/0.517, 123/150 speed improvement, 0.942 condition-averaged) reproduces verbatim from the committed log and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the effect plainly, and use example units spanning a representative R^2 range rather than only the strongest cases.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, the modest single-unit R^2 is reported plainly as 'modest,' and the write-up volunteers specific caveats about the underpowered small session and the planning/movement PD dissociation.
